第241章圣人再聚紫霄宫，女娲明悟自我道
此刻紫霄宫中，已是天道圣人签押封神榜之后第二次齐聚。
只不过这一次，已少了通天教主。
紫霄宫之中的气氛明显有几分不对劲。
尤其是天道四大圣人，老子吃瘪气运跌落，元始天尊重伤，西方功德几乎被套了一个底朝天。
只有女娲还是相当滋润，如今无论是修为还是气运，都远在四大圣人之上。
青玉云台之上，端坐的正是天道鸿钧。
老子看了一眼元始天尊，此刻元始天尊这才开口道：“老师，弟子今日前来，是为通天师弟之事，他自恃诛仙四剑之利，在岐山之上布下恶阵与我等四圣相抗，更纵容门下弟子助纣为虐，搅乱封神量劫秩序。”
“如今通天最终兵解陨落，虽是他自取其祸，然弟子念及同门之谊，心中终究不忍，只是通天师弟如此行事，实在有负老师当年传道之恩，有违天道之正理，弟子还请老师明鉴。”
女娲一听，却是冷哼一声，道：“元始师兄此言，未免太过偏颇了，通天师兄在岐山布阵，固然有违天道常理，可他诛仙阵中四圣齐攻，他以一敌四最后兵解之时，本可以六魂幡将四位圣人尽数送入天道轮回之中，他既留了一线生机，便说明他心中仍有同门之谊。”
“师兄在他兵解之后还要这般中伤于他，岂非让三界六道看了笑话？”
元始天尊自知理亏，并没有多说，而是等着鸿钧发话。
鸿钧道：“通天兵解，皆在量劫规律之中，自在天理之内，此事不必再议，尔等遵循本心去办便是。”
鸿钧一句话算是给天道四大圣人吃了一颗定心丸。
沉默片刻之后，老子却再次开口，“老师，弟子还有一事禀告，自火云宫三皇五帝自解封印以来，人教气运已是大损，如今人皇帝辛在泰山之上持轩辕剑号令九州，驱逐人教道统，更以轩辕剑中亿万亡魂之怨为凭，断我人教根基，此等种种，皆因女娲在暗中扶持人皇所致，若无她多年算计，人教何至沦落至此？”
听到老子的指摘，女娲淡然一笑，那笑容之中带着几分毫不掩饰的嘲讽：“老子此言倒是有趣，你当年一纸批复人族可杀之，但需留吾道统放任妖族屠戮亿万人族，如今人皇帝辛以轩辕剑中亡魂为凭清算这笔旧账，你便说是我算计了你？”
“天道有轮回，因果有报偿，老子你当年种下的因，今日结出的果，怨不得旁人。”
老子面色铁青，正要再言，准提道人已是再也忍不住了，此刻准提道人哭丧着脸，道：“老师，弟子也要告状，西方教八宝功德殿中的十二品功德金莲，还有那积累了万古的功德圣水，已经被人窃取殆尽，那蚊道人不知从何处潜入须弥山，将弟子与师兄的立教根本吸得干干净净。”
“此等行径，分明是有人蓄意而为，背后必有人指使！”
“洪荒大教乃天道之根基，此等便是断送天道大势，还请老师做主啊！”

此言一出，就连几位圣人都忍不住微微侧目，十二品功德金莲乃是接引道人的伴生至宝，与西方教气运紧密相连。
一旦被毁，西方教的根基便如同被抽走了最粗的一根顶梁柱。
第241章圣人再聚紫霄宫，女娲明悟自我道
元始天尊看了准提道人一眼，眼中掠过一丝复杂的神色，却并未开口。
鸿钧的目光落在准提道人身上，那道朦胧的视线仿佛穿透了万古时空，看到了当初西方教东渡以来的一切因果流转。
“当年你若不干涉封神因果，便不会有今日之遭遇，种下了什么因，便要承担什么果，那蚊道人与十二品功德金莲之间的因果，是你自己一手促成，怨不得旁人。”
准提道人正想哭诉一番，却听鸿钧继续补刀道：“准提，你二人当初立教之时已反出玄门，你吾二人已无这师徒缘分。”
准提道人浑身一颤，终究还是没敢再多说什么。
“封神量劫，本为天地气运重定之劫，非一人一教可以独断，通天兵解，已在劫数之中，人皇立誓，亦在劫数之中，一切变化，皆为量劫之波澜，而非量劫之根本。”
“元始，你既领受天道法旨执掌封神榜，当知此劫未完之前，天机不可尽泄，天数不可尽改。”
“尔等圣人，修的是超脱之道，非干涉之道，劫数之终点为何，不在尔等手中，而在天地气运自行流转之中，你若想完此劫，便当依天道法旨而行。”
元始天尊面色微凛，低声道：“弟子谨遵老师教诲。”
鸿钧微微点头，又道：“人教气运之失非是当年一念之差，而是老子你经营不善，而西方功德之失，起于东来干涉之因，非蚊道一人之果，你二人若执意要寻仇报复，便是自陷劫中，莫怪天道无情。”
“只不过封神量劫之后，天道自有因果奖赏，劫完之前，紫霄宫不会再开，尔等好自为之。”
在鸿钧离开之前，却意味深长的看了一眼女娲。
仅是这一个眼神，就让女娲混元十八重天的道行微微一颤，似有警告，似有训诫，不过鸿钧合身天道，女娲也不敢在紫霄宫中随意揣测鸿钧的心思。
四大圣人还在商议封神量劫接下来的走向，可女娲已经无心再在紫霄宫之中待下去。
出了紫霄宫之后，女娲心思一定。
鸿钧这一个眼神却给了她一种莫名的危机感，如今天道五大圣人之中，通天兵解，四大圣人气运跌落，只有她一人被动被杨易卷入了大劫之中，反而得了最大的好处。
到了这个份上，女娲反而感觉不到天道对她有多么大的辅助，隐约之间有一种被天道压制的迹象。

女娲似也明白了一个问题，或许学通天教主，将自我从圣人法体之中斩出来，或许也能给自己留一条退路。
封神量劫之中，天道需要避让量劫因果，或许在完劫之前这是唯一的机会。
否则未来天道干预三界因果，她这个天道圣人再想做出逾越规矩的事，只怕万无可能，到时候念头一起，又将会是天地间下一场量劫的开始。
“看来，是得寻一个机会，将这杨易抓上大素天来助本宫分出自我了。”
“此会大素天之后便关闭娲皇宫，早日参悟魔神因果才是正道......”

Chapter 241 The saints gather again at Zixiao Palace, and Nuwa realizes her true self.
At this moment, in Zixiao Palace, it was the second time that the Tiandao saints gathered together after signing the list of gods.
Only this time, the leader of Tongtian Cult was missing.
There was something obviously wrong with the atmosphere in Zixiao Palace.
Especially for the four great saints of heaven, Lao Tzu suffered a decline in luck, Yuanshi Tianzong was injured, and the Western merits were almost turned upside down.
Only Nuwa is still quite nourished, and now she is far ahead of the four great saints in terms of cultivation and luck.
Sitting on the sapphire cloud platform is Tiandao Hongjun.
I glanced at Yuanshi Tianzun, and Yuanshi Tianzun spoke at this moment: "Teacher, this disciple came here today because of the affairs of Junior Brother Tongtian. He relied on the power of the Four Swords of Execution to Immortal and set up a vicious formation on Qishan Mountain to fight against us and the Four Saints. He also allowed his disciples to help the tyrants and disrupt the order of the Conferred God Calamity."
"Now that Tongtian has finally fallen, although he brought it upon himself, the disciple thinks of the friendship between his fellow disciples and cannot bear it in his heart. However, by acting like this, Junior Brother Tongtian is really betraying the teacher's kindness and goes against the principles of heaven. I also ask the teacher for a clear warning."
When Nuwa heard this, she snorted coldly and said: "Brother Yuanshi's words are too biased. Brother Tongtian's formation in Qishan is certainly against the laws of heaven, but the four saints in his Immortal Killing Formation attacked together. When he finally retreated with four against one, he could have sent all four saints into the reincarnation of heaven with the six soul flags. Since he left a glimmer of hope, it shows that he still has the friendship of the same sect in his heart."
"Senior brother, if he still slanders him like this after he is dismissed, isn't it a joke to the Three Realms and Six Paths?"
Yuanshi Tianzun knew that he was in the wrong, so he didn't say much, but waited for Hongjun to speak.
Hongjun said: "The solutions to Tongtian's military affairs are all within the laws of calamity and within the laws of nature. There is no need to discuss this matter anymore. You can just follow your heart and do it."
Hongjun's words were a reassurance for the four great saints of Heaven.
After a moment of silence, I spoke again, "Teacher, disciple, I have one more thing to report. Since the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors of Huoyun Palace unsealed themselves, the fate of the human religion has been greatly damaged. Now the human emperor Xin is holding the Xuanyuan Sword on Mount Tai to give orders. Jiuzhou expelled the human religion, and even used the resentment of hundreds of millions of dead souls in Xuanyuan Sword to destroy the foundation of our human religion. All these are due to Nuwa secretly supporting the human emperor. Without her years of calculation, how could the human religion have fallen to this point? "
Hearing Laozi's accusation, Nuwa smiled lightly, with a hint of undisguised sarcasm in her smile: "What I said is interesting. Back then, you approved the human race to kill them, but you had to leave my Taoist order to let the demon race slaughter hundreds of millions of human beings. Now the human emperor Xin uses the souls of the dead in the Xuanyuan Sword as a basis to settle this old score, and you say that I set up a plot against you?"
"There is reincarnation in the way of heaven, and there is reward for cause and effect. I cannot blame anyone else for the results you have reaped from the causes you planted back then."
I looked livid, and when I was about to say something else, Taoist Zhunti couldn't bear it any longer. At this moment, Taoist Zhunti said with a mournful face, "Teacher, this disciple also wants to file a complaint. The 12th-grade Golden Lotus of Merit and Virtue in the Eight Treasures Hall of Merit and Virtue of the Western Sect, as well as the holy water of accumulated merit and merit for eternity, have been stolen. That Taoist Mosquito sneaked into Mount Sumeru from nowhere and completely sucked away the foundation of the disciples and senior brothers."
"Such actions are clearly done deliberately, and there must be someone behind the scenes!"
"The great religion of the ancient world is the foundation of the way of heaven. This is ruining the general trend of the way of heaven. You still ask the teacher to make the decision!"
As soon as these words came out, even several saints couldn't help but look slightly sideways. The twelve-grade golden lotus of merit is the companion treasure that guides Taoists, and is closely connected with the fate of Western religions.
Once it is destroyed, the foundation of Western religion will be as if the thickest pillar has been taken away.
Chapter 241 The saints gather again at Zixiao Palace, and Nuwa realizes her true self.
Yuanshi Tianzun glanced at Taoist Zhunti, a complicated look flashed in his eyes, but he did not speak.
Hongjun's eyes fell on the targetReferring to the Taoist, the hazy vision seemed to penetrate through eternity of time and space, and saw all the cause and effect flows since the Western Sect's eastward journey.
"If you had not interfered with the cause and effect of the Conferred God back then, you would not have experienced what you are experiencing today. Whatever the cause is, you will bear the consequences. The cause and effect between Taoist Mosquito and the Golden Lotus of Twelve Grade Merits was caused by you yourself. You cannot blame others."
Taoist Zhunti was about to cry, but he heard Hongjun continue to say: "Zhunti, you two have turned away from Taoism when you first established the religion. You and I no longer have the fate of master and disciple."
Taoist Zhunti trembled all over, but in the end he didn't dare to say anything more.
"The calamity of the Conferred Gods is originally a calamity of redetermination of the destiny of the world. It cannot be decided by one person or one religion. The solution of the Heavenly Arms is already in the calamity. The Human Emperor has sworn that it is also in the calamity. All changes are the waves of the calamity, not the root of the calamity."
"Yuanshi, since you have accepted the laws of heaven and are in charge of the list of gods, you should know that before this calamity is over, the secrets of heaven cannot be revealed and the numbers of heaven cannot be completely changed."
"You saints are cultivating the path of detachment and non-interference. The end point of the calamity is not in your hands, but in the flow of the destiny of heaven and earth. If you want to complete this calamity, you should act in accordance with the laws of heaven."
Yuanshi Tianzun looked slightly stern and said in a low voice: "Disciple, please follow the teacher's teachings."
Hongjun nodded slightly and said: "The failure of the human religion's destiny is not due to a mistake in one's thoughts back then, but to your poor management. The loss of merit in the West is due to interference from the east and is not the result of one person from the Mosquito Way. If you two insist on seeking revenge, you will be in trouble. Don't blame the ruthlessness of heaven."
"It's just that after the catastrophe of the Conferred Gods, heaven will have its own karmic rewards. Before the tribulation is over, the Zixiao Palace will not be reopened, so you can take care of yourself."
Before Hongjun left, he took a meaningful look at Nuwa.
Just this look made Nuwa's Taoism at the eighteenth level of Hunyuan tremble slightly, as if there was a warning or an admonishment, but Hongjun fit the way of heaven, and Nuwa did not dare to speculate on Hongjun's thoughts in the Zixiao Palace.
The four great saints are still discussing the next direction of the Conferred God Calamity Tribulation, but Nuwa has no intention of staying in Zixiao Palace any longer.
After leaving Zixiao Palace, Nuwa had a certain mind.
Hongjun's look gave her an inexplicable sense of crisis. Among the five saints of Heaven, Tongtian's soldiers were defeated, and the luck of the four saints fell. She was the only one who was passively involved in the catastrophe by Yang Yi, but gained the greatest benefit.
At this point, Nuwa didn't feel how much help the Heavenly Dao had to her, and there was a vague sign of being suppressed by the Heavenly Dao.
Nuwa also seemed to understand a problem. Maybe she could learn from the leader Tongtian and cut herself out of the saint's legal body, which might also leave a way out for herself.
During the Conferring God Calamity, Heaven needs to avoid measuring the cause and effect of the calamity. Perhaps this is the only chance before the calamity is completed.
Otherwise, in the future, if Heaven intervenes in the cause and effect of the three realms, it will be impossible for her, a Saint of Heaven, to do something that goes beyond the rules. When the time comes, the next catastrophe in the world will begin.
"It seems that we have to find an opportunity to capture Yang Yi to Da Sutian to help me separate myself."
"After this meeting, the Wa Palace will be closed. The right way is to understand the cause and effect of the devil as soon as possible..."
